plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Physics, McCausland College of Arts and Sciences, Dept. of Physics & Astronomy, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_phys_map.pdf). All 8 semesters transcribed; semester sums verified against printed totals (14/17/16/15/16/13/15/14 at slot minimums = 120, matches Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 32 major, 42-54 college/program, 34-46 Carolina Core, 2.000 GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: CSCE 145 (4)/CSCE 106 (3) at 3. MATH 300/344/500+ choice slots in Semesters Five and Seven use distinct codes. Experimental Physics Elective (4 hrs, CC-INT): PHYS 511/542. Foreign language proficiency equivalent to the 122 course; one U.S. + one non-U.S. History required; last 30 hrs in residence. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
